packageRules.description: Crates only xtask uses, which the shipped mod bundle's normal and build graph never reaches, so a bump of one is a chore. A crate xtask declares that a mod also pulls in through ember-sdk stays a fix.
ember-sdk is this author's own crate, so a new release is taken the day it is published rather than after the cooldown.

vendor/enshrouded-ember is this author's own repository, kept for `cargo xtask server` and `schema` and for building against Ember's source. A git ref carries no release timestamp, so under timestamp-required the pointer never moves unless the cooldown is lifted for it.
